'''GR-18''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that operated during the time of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The droid was present on [[Gravity Hook Seven]] during the [[Conquest of Makeb]].
